item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. You've got a wind-down routine on the calendar tonight and a set bedtime after it. That only works if you protect it — no letting the day's business creep past when relaxation starts. You've got a packed schedule today, which makes it tempting to push bedtime back "just this once." Don't. Sleep is what lets everything else you're working on actually stick. Action: when wind-down time hits, stop what you're doing and start it, no negotiating.
